description:
One retrieved chunk, its locators and the score of every stage that ran for it.

``score`` is on [0, 1] in every mode: cosine similarity (``vector``), the
reciprocal-rank fusion normalised to its maximum (``fused``) or the
cross-encoder logit through a sigmoid (``rerank``); ``score_source`` says which.

fused_score.description: Reciprocal-rank fusion, normalised to (0, 1]; hybrid mode only.
fused_score.title: Fused Score

kb_id.description: The knowledge base the chunk belongs to; null from a pre-V5-04 api.
kb_id.title: Kb Id

lexical_rank.description: 1-based rank in the keyword list; null when not in it (or not hybrid).
lexical_rank.title: Lexical Rank

meta.description: The chunk's locators: `filename`, and for chunks ingested since V5-01 `heading_path`, `page`, `char_start`, `char_end`.
meta.title: Meta

rerank_score.description: Cross-encoder relevance through a sigmoid, (0, 1); reranked hits only.
rerank_score.title: Rerank Score

vector_score.description: Cosine similarity to the query; null when not in the vector list.
vector_score.title: Vector Score

title: KbHit
